Original prototype/spec-interaction.dc.html:81 explicitly requires only the page-number preview to update during a seek drag, with target-page decoding and display deferred until release. A real pending seek number is therefore permitted to differ from the committed page.

The accepted artwork-only closed-reader override excludes a persistent ribbon, footer, status bar, notification, decorative gutter, and lower-right footer-cycle target. Image-fitting white margins and actual artwork differences are not themselves viewport defects.
The UI/UX Pro Max skill was read for visual and interaction review guidance. Existing project-specific acceptance rules take precedence.

limitations: This supplemental assignment supplied eight candidate PNGs and no independent reference PNG. Visual review is limited to these candidates and the applicable textual reference declarations.

Only existing PNG, JSON, and text evidence was read; Get-FileHash was used for the requested identity checks. No application, prototype, build, test, smoke test, validation suite, or runtime probe was launched on the local machine.

Static captures cannot independently establish exact tap coordinates, RTL or reversed event mapping, input generation fences, release-time decoding, persistence behavior, or the absence of an invisible footer-cycle hit target.
A --resume capture and its supplied checks are not independent physical sleep/wake or e-ink hardware qualification.
The processed-artwork oracle's reported zero pixel differences were considered supporting evidence, not a substitute for individually viewing every candidate PNG.
Several differently numbered demo pages share the same even or odd fixture artwork. Repeated PNG pixels alone do not prove that the underlying committed page stayed unchanged or changed.
First/last seek endpoint placement, hidden hardware controls, authorization flows, and other states outside these eight cases were not inspected.
No new actionable visual issue was confirmed in this batch. This report does not assert a complete-matrix clean round.
